entities.name: PMID:25435901
observations: 2014 Chemistry Central Journal study titled Anthraquinonyl glycoside facilitates the standardization of graphene electrodes for the impedance detection of lectins.

entities.name: ZBW1 anthraquinonyl glycoside
observations: ZBW1/AG couples a mannose glycoside recognition element to an anthraquinone graphene-binding and electroactive moiety.
Its intrinsic anthraquinone voltammetric signal quantifies glycoside decoration and supports electrode quality control.

entities.name: Nano-graphene screen-printed electrode
observations: A screen-printed working electrode precoated with nano-graphene was functionalized by spotting ZBW1.
Electrodes were selected within a unified anthraquinone signal window for standardized functionalization.

entities.name: Concanavalin A
observations: Mannose-selective Concanavalin A was the lectin analyte; impedance spectroscopy assessed its adhesion to the glycoside-functionalized graphene electrode.

entities.name: Ferri/ferrocyanide redox probe
observations: The external [Fe(CN)6]3−/4− couple was used for the impedance readout, distinct from the anthraquinone signal used for electrode standardization.
